result.question: How does Uzziah follow his father's example?

readings.answer: By doing what was right in the eyes of the LORD.
readings.support: he did what was right in the eyes of the LORD, just as his father Amaziah had done

assessments.reason: Verse 26:4 explicitly says he did what was right in the LORD’s eyes just as his father Amaziah had done; the key’s added “sought God” is not presented as part of following his father’s example.
